notes.title: Zombie Outbreak 1943 - OUT NOW
notes.content: [p align="start"]I'm pleased to announce Zombie Outbreak 1943 is OUT NOW.  This game has come a long way with a large list of improvements thanks to community feedback from Zombie Outbreak 1942.[/p][p][/p][p]The game features all-new maps and a complete overhaul to the graphics and weapons systems.  All environments are even higher-quality,  featuring full high-definition rendering and textures up to 4K resolution and beyond. [/p][p][/p][p align="start"]If you're interested, head on over to the store page and consider adding it to your wishlist, or jump straight into the action and start fighting zombies right now! notes.title: Zombie Outbreak LAUNCHES on May 21st
notes.content:
We look forward to having players experience the thrill and excitement of this new zombie survival shooter,  based in 1942 in the middle of World War 2.   You will be given the chance to fight zombies in several environments,  maps,  with features that remind you of classic zombie survival.   

Your objective is to survive for as long as possible,  which can easily be achieved by exploring your environments and finding better weapons,  explosives,  or zombie traps.

[b]ZOMBIE SURVIVAL MODE[/b]

Use classic weapons from World War II to fight zombies in thrilling environments and mysterious locations.  Explore your surroundings to find secrets and survive for as long as possible while earning Steam Achievements and earning a higher position on the Steam Leaderboards.

The zombies are more determined with every passing second,  so you'll need to use your instincts in order to survive the zombie outbreak. 

[b]GAMEPLAY FEATURES[/b]

[list]
[*] Time-Based Zombie Survival Mode
[*] Multiple HDRP Zombie Survival Maps & Locations
[*] Full Controller Support for PlayStation and Xbox Controllers
[*] Steam Leaderboards
[*] Steam Achievements
[/list]
